query.title: Keyword (optional)
query.description: Free text matched on company name and trade names, e.g. "boulangerie", "garage", "plombier".

nafCodes.title: Activity codes (NAF/APE)
nafCodes.description: One or more NAF codes, e.g. 56.10A (restaurants), 96.02A (hairdressers), 96.02B (beauty salons), 45.20A (car repair), 43.22A (plumbing), 68.31Z (real estate agencies).

section.title: Activity section (A–U)
section.description: Optional broad INSEE section letter, e.g. I = accommodation & food, F = construction, G = retail & trade.

revenueMin.title: Minimum revenue (€)
revenueMin.description: Only companies with published accounts above this revenue.

createdAfter.title: Company created after (YYYY-MM-DD)
createdAfter.description: Keep only companies created on or after this date (filters the returned pages).

excludeSoleTraders.title: Exclude sole traders (recommended, GDPR)
excludeSoleTraders.description: Sole traders are natural persons; they are excluded by default.

outputMode.title: One row per
enumTitles: Local branch matching your filters (best for local prospecting)
